params.caption: 🖥️ Judge refuses to toss RAM price-fixing lawsuit against Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix The three memory giants asked the court to dismiss the class action accusing them of fixing RAM prices and supply, and the judge said no. The case will now continue, at a time when memory prices are hitting PC builders hard. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 18:39 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GamesRadar+ · VGC 💸 Paid too much for RAM this year?
